cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Closer on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to repair the relationship while redefining closeness around the boundaries that benefit you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I'd love a weekend to patch things up. Separate rooms, though, and no old arguments.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The old arguments are why we need the weekend.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then let's start with a pleasant afternoon. We can rebuild from there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't fit everything I need to say into an afternoon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Send the rest by email. I'll read it when I'm ready, and we can keep the afternoon for us.
